name: Libram of Resilience

guaranteedRewards.name: Lesser Arcanum of Resilience
tooltip: Use: Permanently adds 20 fire resistance to a leg or head slot item. Does not stack with other enchantments for the selected equipment slot.

narrative.offerRewardText: Other librams are lost in this world. Lost in places you would not dare enter. Places you would pray did not exist.I will drink in the energies of these components. You shall be given the residual waste...
narrative.requestItemsText: If it is resilience you desire, thirty gold I require.
